clips.title: The story
paras: At Bashal'Aran, Asterion seeks release from the magic binding his ghostly form. He suspects the grells have touched the seal that holds him, and asks travelers to gather their earrings so he can trace its lingering magic.

Asterion waits among Bashal'Aran's shattered marble, bound there for centuries. The ancient night elf spirit is trapped between life and true death beneath Darkshore's canopy. Arcane craft ties him to the ruined settlement, and he cannot break free alone. Solitude and despair have worn down his mind through all those years.

Asterion believes an ancient seal hidden in the ruins may hold the key to his release. Though he cannot search the brush and fallen stones himself, the feral grells of Bashal'Aran forage there and steal small baubles. He asks travelers to gather their earrings, hoping the trinkets' lingering magic will lead him to the seal that torments his soul.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If I were to relate the story of my life, I have no doubt it would surpass the limits of your patience. Let us say that mine has been a long and painful life, and this spectral form is perhaps the worst torment of all.

I am held here by the means of magic. Though my words may seem disingenuous, I assure you I would be grateful beyond words if you would help me find the means of my imprisonment. A seal binds me, and by examining the earpieces of the sprites and grells, I may find a trace of it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Once I have the earrings, I will cast the spell to search for the whereabouts of the seal that binds me. For centuries I have thought on the freedom destroying the seal would bring to me... Perhaps those centuries have taken a toll upon my mind that I might never recover...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Indeed... The grells of Bashal'Aran do not possess that which I am searching... However they have come into contact with it
Recently. Recently... I would reckon that by your time, not mine. Recent for me stretches into the veil of the past, almost another Age...
